name: Labelbox
tagline: Data factory for AI teams — labeling, evals, and human data for training.
description: Labelbox is a platform for generating and managing training data for AI models, combining annotation tools (Annotate), data curation (Catalog), and model-assisted labeling and evaluation (Model Foundry). It now spans reinforcement-learning data, custom evals, robotics datasets, and an on-demand network of expert human labelers, metered by a usage-based Labelbox Unit (LBU).
insight: Raised a $110M Series D led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 in 2022 (~$189M raised total); founded in 2018 by Manu Sharma.

modelSupport.notes: Produces training and eval data and labels for any model.

edge: Combines an enterprise labeling UI, model-assisted pre-labeling, and an on-demand expert-labeler network in one usage-metered platform.
pros: Spans RLHF, robotics, and eval datasets
cons: Usage-based LBU pricing hard to forecast
Enterprise focus, steeper for small teams
